name: Enbridge Marquez Plant Line
monitor_reason: endpoints and independent sourcing: EIA is the only source; no start/end points, no verifiable owner or route; no roster row matches
researcher_notes: No roster row matches (no Marquez, Enbridge, or Eagle Ford line in the US gas roster). The EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), has two rows. Excel row 440: Enbridge Energy Pipeline Co, lateral, completed 2007, 56 mi, 24 inch, 250 MMcf/d, intrastate, Texas. Excel row 654: owner Enterprise Products Partners, expansion, completed September 2010, 69 mi, 16 and 36 inch, intrastate, Texas. The two rows may be phases of one line, or the same line after an ownership change; EIA does not say. The pipeline would be operating, so the length is not the issue. What fails is that EIA gives no endpoints, and no second source names the pipeline. Web searches found Enbridge's Marquez gas plant in Leon County, Texas, and Enterprise's Eagle Ford expansion articles, but none that names the Marquez Plant Line. Two Oil and Gas Journal articles loaded but do not contain the name. EIA verifier passed for the name. Intrastate, so FERC silence is not a concern; the next step would be the Texas Railroad Commission T-4 permit records or the Enterprise or Enbridge filings, to find the endpoints and owner. Parked as monitor.
